text: This staff report is about a matter for which Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision provided it is in keeping with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting authority to enter into an encroachment agreement with the owners of 55 De Vere Gardens for a 2.0 metres high wooden fence with a variable setback 1.8 metres to 2.1 metres from the roadway curb; a 3.5 metres high wooden pool shed with a length and width of 2.8 metres located inside the fenced area, setback 2.4 metres from the roadway curb on the Harley Avenue flankage of the subject premises. The fence on the public right of way does not meet the requirements of the City of Toronto Municipal Code, Chapter 743, Streets and Sidewalks, Use of, and there is no provision for an encroaching shed on the public right of way. North York Community Council: 1. Approved the request to maintain a 2.0 metres high wooden fence and wooden pool shed on the flankage of the subject premises on the public right of way at 55 De Vere Gardens, subject to the following conditions: a. the property owners enter into an encroachment agreement with the City of Toronto at the applicant's expense and assume all liability and damages related to the encroachments; b. the property owners must retain valid property insurance for the duration of the encroachments in case there are any claims initiated due to the encroachments; c. the property owners agree that the City and/or utility companies may remove the fence and the pool shed in order to install or maintain services within the affected public right of way with no obligation to replace these encroachments; d. the property owners remove the overgrown hedges between the roadway…
